title: Two Classic Games Become Best Friends Thanks to Mods!
summary: What happens when you mix a legendary fantasy RPG with a classic online world? You get Morrowind looking like Final Fantasy 11! Two clever mods (short for modifications, which are fan-made add-ons) have transformed the 2002 game 'The Elder Scrolls 3: Morrowind' to feel like Square Enix's beloved MMO. One mod, called 'FF-HUD for OpenMW,' swaps the in-game cursor and other screen elements to match Final Fantasy 11's style. The other, 'FF11 Style Menu BG and Button Replacer,' gives the main menu a makeover with that iconic Final Fantasy look. Both are free to download on Nexus Mods, but they work best with the OpenMW version of the game. Why mix these two? Well, they're like long-lost siblings. Both were released in 2002, and they share a love for letting players explore at their own pace. As the mod creator Hayakawadono said, 'Morrowind and FF11 somewhat always felt to me like if they were some kind of half-siblings.' Sure, both games have clunky parts — Morrowind's messy journal, Final Fantasy 11's punishing death system — but fans adore them for their depth. These mods don't change the gameplay; they just make the two worlds feel even closer. It's like giving your favorite old game a cozy new coat of paint. If you love getting lost in huge, detailed worlds, this mashup might be your perfect weekend adventure!
why_it_matters: This shows how creative fans can keep old games alive, and it reminds us that shared passions can connect different communities.

background_read: Morrowind, from the Elder Scrolls series, and Final Fantasy 11, by Square Enix, are both classic games from 2002 that many people still love.
Mods (short for modifications) let fans give old games new looks or features, and Nexus Mods is a website where players can download thousands of these free add-ons.
In Morrowind, you explore a wide-open fantasy world, while Final Fantasy 11 was an early online multiplayer game known for its challenging death system.
Article_Structure: WHO: Mod creator Hayakawadono and fans of two classic games.
WHAT: Two mods changed Morrowind's menu and on-screen looks to match Final Fantasy 11's iconic style.
WHERE: Available for free on Nexus Mods, and they work best with the OpenMW version of the game.
WHY: Because the two 2002 games share a similar spirit of open exploration and feel like long-lost half-siblings.

perspectives.description: Mods let players customize their experience and celebrate two beloved games, combining their best artistic parts.
Some might say these mods are just for looks and don't fix the original clunky gameplay or punishing systems.
Modding culture keeps classic titles relevant and may inspire new fans to try games from decades ago that they otherwise would miss.
